components.label: Projector body
components.purpose: Molded plastic cabinet that houses the laser light source, the optical engine, cooling and electronics.
components.action: Lift and place with enough people for a 23.2 kg unit. Keep every air intake and exhaust port clear.
components.basis: Printed size 498 x 200 x 538 mm and molded plastic cabinet. Corner radii and seam lines follow the outline. Finish and surface detail are styling. The fifth front indicator position is drawn unlit: the operating instructions say it is not used with this projector.

components.label: Adjustable feet
components.purpose: Four feet that carry the projector on a floor or table and set the projection angle.
components.action: Turn a foot to extend it, up to about 30 mm each, and turn it back to retract. Retract the feet before transport. For any mounting other than standing on its feet, use the screw holes for ceiling mount.
components.basis: Printed spacing 442 mm across and 457 mm front to back. The CAD outline draws the right rear foot about 25 mm forward of the left rear foot, and that is followed. Shape is a stand-in.

components.label: Air intake port, front
components.purpose: Draws cooling air in through the grille beside the lens.
components.action: Keep it clear. Do not block the ventilation ports.
components.basis: Front face, beside the lens on the projector's right.

components.label: Air intake port, left side
components.purpose: Draws cooling air in through the grille along the left side.
components.action: Keep it clear. Do not block the ventilation ports.
components.basis: A grille along most of the left side.

components.label: Air intake ports, bottom
components.purpose: Draw cooling air in through slotted openings in the base.
components.action: Keep the base clear of cloth, paper and soft surfaces. Do not block the ventilation ports.
components.basis: Three slotted rows in the base: one across the front and two along the right. The operating instructions mark the same three.

components.label: Air exhaust port
components.purpose: Blows heated air out across the rear face.
components.action: Keep hands, faces and heat-sensitive objects away, and keep it clear. Do not block the ventilation ports.
components.basis: One grille across the rear face.

components.label: Remote control signal receiver, front
components.purpose: Receives the remote control signal from in front of the projector.
components.action: Aim the remote control at it and keep it unobstructed.
components.basis: Front face, top corner on the projector's right.

components.label: Remote control signal receiver, rear
components.purpose: Receives the remote control signal from behind the projector.
components.action: Aim the remote control at it and keep it unobstructed.
components.basis: Rear face, inside the top of the exhaust grille.

components.label: Power indicator ON (G)/STANDBY (R)

components.action: Read it on the projector before working on it. This model does not light it.
components.basis: Front, on the top edge to the right of the lens. The name is from the operating instructions.

components.label: Light source indicator LIGHT1

components.label: Light source indicator LIGHT2

components.label: Screw holes for ceiling mount
components.purpose: Five M6 screw holes in the base for fixing the projector to a ceiling mount bracket or another mount.
components.action: Use these, not the feet, for any mounting other than standing on its feet. Screws are M6 with 12 mm of thread inside the projector, tightened to 4 +/- 0.5 N m. Leave no gap between the holes and the mounting surface: fit metal spacers.
components.basis: Five holes. The CAD outline prints their positions from the cabinet centre: 125 and 122.5 mm across, 135 and 129 mm forward, 80.5 and 145 mm back.

identity.readPath: Panasonic file opened directly on 13 November 2026

layout.basis: Part names and the face each sits on are from the operating instructions. Positions are measured from the six views of the PT-RZ970 series CAD outline.

dimensions.basis: Outer size follows the printed 498 x 200 x 538 mm and the lens ends 43 mm beyond it. Nothing was measured on a unit.

unknowns: The CAD outline covers seven models. A detail that differs on the PT-RZ970 alone would not show.
Connector bodies, the mains inlet type and the switch: schematic stand-ins.
Ribbed bars low on both sides, shown in the drawings: not drawn. The operating instructions do not name them.
The fifth front indicator position: drawn unlit as part of the body. The operating instructions say it is not used with this projector.
Bottom detail beyond the named ports: ribs, ducts, the rear arch and the centre of gravity mark are not drawn.
The earthing warning label on the terminal panel and the three logos on the top cover: not drawn.
Product marking positions: the wordmark follows the CAD outline; the model label is generated text placed in the blank label area the outline shows.
Which variant a given unit is: the entry is the model. A nameplate would say.
